metaDescription: Order custom stock buttons, stickers & patches in bulk. Fast turnaround on standard shapes. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Stock-shaped buttons, stickers, and patches are the go-to choice when you need reliable, cost-effective promotional items without custom die costs. Standard round or square shapes fit most automated production lines, keeping your per-unit price low and delivery fast. Whether you're equipping a tradeshow team with 1" lapel pins or handing out 3" button cards at a rally, stock shapes ensure consistent quality. Decorate with full-color imprint or foil stamp for added impact. Perfect for safety managers ordering PPE reminder badges or HR directors running employee recognition programs.
heroAltText: Assorted custom stock buttons stickers and patches in standard round and square shapes for bulk orders
